shared_elements: a hand or limb rendered in relief
figures arranged in a horizontal sequence
justification: Both surfaces carry relief figures set out in a roughly horizontal sequence, and both seem to include profile heads and at least one clearly modelled hand, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. B shows a specific, highly conventionalised procession of bearded men in tall fluted headdresses holding spears and bows, framed by bands of rosettes, while A shows only massive, rounded, indistinct forms with no identifiable dress, attributes, or framing ornament, and no comparable procession scheme.
